directAnswer.en: This is a grid-powered building pour through a pipeline. Read this page as horizontal 120 m and delivery height 360 m, output 50 m³/h. Do not replace those cells with the 900 m row. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists HBT80-16 at 110 kW, 50 m³/h, 40 MPa, horizontal conveying 120 m, delivery height 360 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm and 6500 kg. The model cell also prints HBT80-1816-110. Do not move the same condition onto Electric 80, which prints 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical, aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm), hopper 0.7 m³, Kawasaki 140 double pump, 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and 6000 kg. The model cell also prints HBT80-1816-110. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.

body.en: Send the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical line you measured, and the supply the printed motor needs. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job, a price or a daily volume.
body.zh: 请发送配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及已印电机需要的电源。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。
